title: I built a browser-based P2P file transfer tool using WebRTC
summary: A lightweight P2P file transfer application built entirely in the browser using WebRTC, enabling direct peer-to-peer connections without server uploads. The tool focuses on privacy and speed by establishing direct browser-to-browser connections for instant file sharing.
problem_solved: Eliminates the need for intermediate servers when transferring files between users, solving privacy concerns and speed limitations of traditional cloud-based file sharing.
why_valuable: Provides instant, private file transfers directly in the browser without requiring account registration, software installation, or trusting third-party servers with data.
